title: SearchOnly OnlyFans Market Data (daily)
description:
Daily aggregate figures about the OnlyFans creator market, measured from public profiles by SearchOnly: profiles indexed, live, new and gone; the share of free accounts; median and average paid subscription prices; weekly price changes. Aggregates only, no creator names or identifiers.

One row per day in data/market-daily.csv; method: searchonly.me/reports/methodology.
